result.summary: 本文提出“柏拉图表示假说”，认为不同神经网络对数据的表示正在趋同，并最终趋向一个反映现实世界统计结构的共享表示 [abstract][S1.p2][S1.p4]。作者综述了文献中跨架构、跨模态以及模型与大脑之间的表示对齐证据，并用78个视觉模型和多个语言模型测量对齐随规模与性能的变化 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。作者提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种可能驱动收敛的机制，并给出一个理想化世界中对比学习收敛到点互信息核的形式化分析 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2][S4.SS2.p6]。作者还讨论了收敛在跨模态数据共享、翻译适配和减少幻觉与偏见方面的可能含义，并明确列出多种反例与局限 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要探讨不同神经网络模型在表示数据时是否正在趋同，以及这种趋同是否会持续、最终收敛到哪里 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者提出的核心假说是存在一个收敛终点和驱动原则：不同模型都在试图得到对现实的表示，即对生成观测数据的现实世界联合分布的表示 [S1.p4]。作者将这一收敛后的假想表示称为“柏拉图表示”，并指出该想法与科学哲学中的收敛实在论以及表示学习文献中的相关论点有关 [S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
We argue that there is a growing similarity in how datapoints are represented in different neural network models.
What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
Our central hypothesis, stated above in Figure 1, is that there is indeed an endpoint to this convergence and a principle that drives it
different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe.
We call this converged hypothetical representation the “platonic representation” in reference to Plato’s Allegory of the Cave
our hypothesis is also related to the notion of “convergent realism” in the philosophy of science

method.text: 作者将表示定义为把输入映射为特征向量的函数，并用其诱导的核来刻画表示，用核对齐度量衡量两个表示的相似性结构 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。实验中作者采用互最近邻度量，即两个核诱导的k近邻集合的平均交集并按k归一化 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。为测量跨模态对齐，作者使用成对数据集作为桥梁，例如用Wikipedia图像-标题数据集，分别计算图像核和文本核并测量其对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。作者还提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种假说来解释收敛，并在理想化世界中对一类对比学习器进行形式化分析，论证其收敛到点互信息核 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2][S4.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: A representation is a function $f\colon\mathcal{X}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{n}$ that assigns a feature vector to each input in some data domain $\mathcal{X}$.
A kernel, $K\colon\mathcal{X}\times\mathcal{X}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$, characterizes how a representation measures distance/similarity between datapoints.
we define representational alignment as a measure of the similarity of the similarity structures induced by two representations
we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels
To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.
we use the Wikipedia captions dataset $\{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i}$, composed of images from Wikipedia ( $x_{i}$) and their corresponding captions ( $y_{i}$).
The Multitask Scaling Hypothesis There are fewer representations that are competent for $N$ tasks than there are for $M<N$ tasks.
The Capacity Hypothesis Bigger models are more likely to converge to a shared representation than smaller models.
The Simplicity Bias Hypothesis Deep networks are biased toward finding simple fits to the data, and the bigger the model, the stronger the bias.
for any modality in our idealized world, we observe representational convergence to the same kernel, which represents certain pairwise statistics of $\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{Z})$.

experiments.text: 在视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了78个视觉模型，这些模型具有不同架构、训练目标和数据集，并用VTAB数据集上的迁移性能进行分箱比较 [S2.SS2.p2]。具体包括17个ViT模型、1个随机初始化ResNet-50、11个ResNet-50和49个ResNet-18模型，对齐度量使用Places-365验证集上1000个图像表示的k=10最近邻 [A3.SS1.p1][A3.SS1.p3]。在跨模态方面，作者比较了BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA等语言模型家族与多种ViT视觉模型，使用WIT数据集的1024个样本、k=10最近邻计算对齐 [A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p2][A3.SS2.p3]。作者还进行了颜色共现案例研究，从CIFAR-10图像共现和语言共现中学习颜色表示，并与CIELAB感知空间比较 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1][A4.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We expand upon this observation by evaluating the transfer performance of $78$ vision models.
These models were trained with varying architectures, training objectives, and datasets
we bin these models based on their average transfer performance on the VTAB dataset, and then measure the average kernel alignment of the models within each bin.
We consider 78 vision models in total
$17$ ViT models ranging from ViT-tiny to ViT-giant
$1$ randomly initialized ResNet-50.
$11$ ResNet-50 models trained with contrastive learning on ImageNet-1k, Places-365
$49$ ResNet-18 models trained with Alignment and Uniformity contrastive loss
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset.
The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
For vision models, we consider ViT models of various sizes trained on various data and objectives.
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT (Wikipedia-based Image Text;).
We conduct a case study to verify that convergence does happen on real data.
We collect color cooccurrence statistics from the CIFAR-10 dataset

findings.text: 作者发现，解决更多VTAB任务的视觉模型彼此更加对齐，高性能模型形成紧密聚集的表示，而弱性能模型的表示更加多变 [S2.SS2.p2]。跨模态方面，语言模型的语言建模能力越强，越倾向于与视觉模型对齐，反之亦然；CLIP模型因显式语言监督表现出更高对齐，但在ImageNet分类微调后对齐下降 [S2.SS3.p5][S2.F3]。对齐还能预测下游性能：与DINOv2对齐更好的LLM在Hellaswag和GSM8K上表现更好 [S2.SS5.p1]。在颜色案例中，从图像共现或语言共现学习到的表示大致恢复出相同的感知表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者还发现，标题描述越密集（信息量越高），其LLM表示与对应图像视觉表示的对齐越好 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p3]。

evidence.quote: The results indicate that models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations.
we find that the better an LLM is at language modeling, the more it tends to aligns with vision models
The converse effect also holds: the better a vision models is, the more it tends to align with LLMs.
We find that CLIP models, which are trained with explicit language supervision, exhibit a higher level of alignment.
However, this alignment decreases after being fine-tuned on ImageNet classification (labeled CLIP (I12K ft)).
Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation.
the more descriptive (higher information) a caption is, the better its LLM representation aligns with the visual representation of the corresponding image.

limitations.text: 作者承认，不同模态可能包含不同信息，两个模型若访问根本不同的信息就无法收敛到相同表示；其数学论证仅严格适用于Z的双射投影，不适用于有损或随机观测函数 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。作者指出目前主要关注视觉和语言两种模态，尚未在所有领域看到同等程度的收敛，例如机器人领域还没有标准化的世界状态表示方式 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者还提到AI社区的研究者偏见和“硬件彩票”可能推动模型向类人表示收敛，而专用智能系统可能不会收敛 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。此外，作者承认对齐度量本身存在争议，且不同模型只达到相似而非相同的表示，例如图3中对齐分数仅达到0.16，而该度量理论最大值为1，这一差距是噪声还是重大差异仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

evidence.quote: Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.
our mathematical argument in Section 4 only strictly holds for bijective projections of $\mathbf{Z}$
This will not hold true for either lossy or stochastic observation functions.
Our argument has mainly focused on two modalities: vision and language.
in robotics there is not yet a standardized approach to representing world states in the same way as there is for representing images and text.
Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.
the “hardware lottery” suggests that the success of AI models can also depend on the compatibility of their design with available computational architectures
Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment.
alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric.
We leave this as an open question.
